description: Structured errors from the last finished geometry run. message is the same text the viewport shows. featureType, featureLabel, and featureIndex identify the failed feature when known. detail is the exception name, a Manifold status, or the kernel message when that text is not already in message. Stack frames and URLs are omitted, and detail is always present on feature_failed: when the kernel adds nothing, it names the helper that threw (move adds how to name the body). Cleared on the next successful run. Feature and kernel failures use code feature_failed. One marked feature block that ran past the time budget while the rest of the part was rebuilt without it is one row with code feature_timeout, featureId, featureType, featureLabel, elapsedMs, budgetMs, workerRestarted: true, and detail (the recovery: fewer edges, a smaller radius, or lower segments; edit, delete, or undo that feature). A geometry engine crash (a wasm abort, out of memory, or a run past its time budget outside any block, or after three retries) is one row with code geometry_worker_crashed, reason (wasm_abort | out_of_memory | timeout | worker_lost), and workerRestarted: the worker was replaced, other parts kept building, and the next run of this part uses the fresh worker; simplify the part, reduce segment counts, or split it up. No reload is needed.
name: errors
